notes: Read all 89 source lines (numbered) before editing. WidgetTipCards is a self-contained reusable shared/ widget primitive (no API hooks, no i18n runtime calls, no DOM beyond Badge/EmptyState/div/span), structurally a sibling of the already-converted WidgetDetailCard, so it ports cleanly to react-native primitives.

L1 `import { useMemo, type ReactNode } from 'react'` -> `import React, {useMemo, type ReactNode} from 'react'`: useMemo (used for the visible slice) and ReactNode (TipItem.icon, WidgetTipCardsProps.emptyIcon) are reused verbatim; the React default import is added because the base @react-native/typescript-config sets jsx:'react-native' (classic runtime compiles JSX to React.createElement, so React must be in scope) — matching every sibling native component.

L2 `import { Badge } from '@/components/ui'` -> an inline native Badge component. The web Badge is a DOM <span> (browser-only); per the WidgetDetailCard inline-reproduction precedent it is reproduced self-contained as a rounded pill (View + AppText), sized like the web `size="sm"` chip (px-1.5 py-0.5 -> paddingHorizontal 6 / paddingVertical 2, text-xs -> fontSize 11, rounded-full -> borderRadius 999, font-medium -> fontWeight '500').

L3 `import { EmptyState } from '@/components/feedback'` -> an inline native EmptyState (centered optional icon + muted message). The canonical native components/feedback EmptyState takes {title, message} with no icon slot, so the web {icon, message, className} usage is reproduced inline (same precedent as WidgetDetailCard).

L4 `import { cn } from '@/lib/cn'` -> dropped: the single cn() call site (L77-80 description compact line-clamp) becomes a static style plus a conditional `numberOfLines={compact ? 2 : undefined}` (line-clamp-2), the react-native styling idiom.

L6-13 `export interface TipItem { id: string | number; icon?: ReactNode; title: string; description: string; impact?: 'high'|'medium'|'low'; impactLabel?: string }` preserved verbatim (still exported — this is the public type other widgets consume).
L15-21 `interface WidgetTipCardsProps { tips: TipItem[]; maxTips?: number; compact?: boolean; emptyMessage?: string; emptyIcon?: ReactNode }` preserved verbatim.

L23-27 the `impactBadgeMap` const (high->success, medium->warning, low->neutral) preserved verbatim with `as const`; a NativeBadgeVariant type derives from it so the inline Badge accepts exactly the mapped union ('success'|'warning'|'neutral').

L29-35 `export function WidgetTipCards({ tips, maxTips, compact = false, emptyMessage, emptyIcon }: WidgetTipCardsProps)` preserved verbatim — same named export, same destructure, same `compact = false` default.
L36 `const limit = maxTips ?? (compact ? 1 : 3)` preserved verbatim (default visible count: 1 when compact, else 3, overridable via maxTips).
L38 `const visible = useMemo(() => tips.slice(0, limit), [tips, limit])` preserved verbatim — same memoised slice with the same [tips, limit] deps.

'No recommendations'` fallback is kept verbatim, the web py-4 maps to the inline EmptyState's paddingVertical 16, emptyIcon is forwarded to the icon slot, and the L42 no-action comment (transient empty state, no recovery action) is copied verbatim above the branch.

L51 `<div className="space-y-2 overflow-y-auto h-full">` -> `<ScrollView style={styles.scroll} contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}>`: scroll.flex=1 (h-full + overflow-y-auto vertical scroller), scrollContent.gap=8 (space-y-2 = 0.5rem inter-card spacing).

L52-56 `visible.map((tip) => <div key={tip.id} className="rounded-lg bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/[0.06] p-3 min-h-[44px] flex items-start gap-3">` -> a View with key={tip.id} and style styles.card: borderRadius 8 (rounded-lg), backgroundColor rgba(255,255,255,0.03) (bg-white/[0.03]), borderColor rgba(255,255,255,0.06) + borderWidth 1 (border border-white/[0.06]), padding 12 (p-3), minHeight 44 (min-h-[44px], a11y tap target), flexDirection row (flex), alignItems flex-start (items-start), gap 12 (gap-3).

The three variants map onto native tokens — success: successSurface/successBorder/success, warning: warningSurface/warningBorder/warning, neutral: surfaceRaised/border/textSecondary — reproducing the web bg-{color}/text-{color} chip in the native dark palette.
